meta.name: I Am Groot
meta.description:
There's no guarding the galaxy from this mischievous toddler! Get ready as Baby Groot takes center stage in his very own collection of shorts, exploring his glory days growing up and getting into trouble among the stars.

Rated TV-G · Canceled · First aired 10 Aug 2022 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Marvel Studios · Network: Disney+

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5

On your server — Audio: English
meta.slogan: A hero of few words returns.

trailerStreams.title: Featurette: Dance Off | Marvel Studios' I Am Groot | Disney+

videos.title: Groot's First Steps
videos.overview: Baby Groot takes his first steps out of his pot, only to learn you have to walk before you can run.

videos.title: The Little Guy
videos.overview: Groot discovers a miniature civilization that believes the seemingly enormous tree toddler is the hero they’ve been waiting for.

videos.title: Groot's Pursuit
videos.overview: Groot investigates a spooky noise that’s been haunting the Quadrant, which leads to an intense dance off.

videos.title: Groot Takes a Bath
videos.overview: Everybody needs some alone time to relax and wash up, but things go quite differently when you’re a Flora Colossi toddler.

videos.title: Magnum Opus
videos.overview: Groot sets out to paint a family portrait of himself and the Guardians, only to discover just how messy the artistic process can be.

videos.title: Are You My Groot?
videos.overview: Groot stumbles across a strange egg in a nest while exploring the alien planet of Terma. He instantly falls for the little creature that emerges when the egg cracks, adopting it as his own.

videos.title: Groot Noses Around
videos.overview: When Groot discovers a bionic nose-shaped device that grants him a sense of smell, he quickly learns not to stick his new nose where it doesn't belong.

videos.title: Groot's Snow Day
videos.overview: After landing on the icy planet of Falligar, Groot fashions a snowman with scraps of junk, inadvertently creating an unstoppable snowman-robot that wreaks havoc.

videos.title: Groot's Sweet Treat
videos.overview: As an intergalactic ice cream truck approaches, Groot—desperate to get a treat— frantically scours the ship for coins

videos.title: Groot and the Great Prophecy
videos.overview: In this adventure narrated by The Watcher, Groot finds himself in the heart of an ancient Drez-Lar temple with a mythic prophecy he must fulfill to save the universe.
